subject: Ownership slicing and role clearing — QBR comms draft
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Ownership slicing and role clearing — QBR comms draft

Team —

I’m sharing a first-pass draft of a short comms note we can use during next week’s QBR to explain the changes we’re proposing to ownership slices across Platform, Serving Runtime, and Observability. High-level goals: reduce cross-team handoffs, make escalation points explicit, and create clean 30/60/90 handoff steps so product squads can plan.

Attached: a concise playbook (ownership-slicing-playbook-v1.pdf) and the slide stub for the QBR (qbr-notes-ownership-slides.pptx). Also left a Drive doc with the outline here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2BOwnershipPlaybook.

Please read with these asks:
- Jonas: can you sanity-check operational impacts and any risks to ongoing migrations?
- Marissa: can you confirm which PMs we should mention by name in the comms and whether we should include a dedicated office hours link?
- Vivek: does this align with the cadences you planned in the pillar leads meeting? Any concerns about bandwidth?

Draft below — this lives in the Drive doc for comment. I’m planning to send the QBR announcement on Tuesday EOD after we incorporate feedback. If there are substantive objections, flag them by Monday 5pm PT.

--- DRAFT COMM —
Subject: Clearer ownership for faster shipping (short update)
Body: Over the past quarter we’ve simplified how teams own platform surface areas to reduce latency between requests and fixes. You’ll see three changes:
1) Consolidated ownership for the serving runtime (Platform) — single team responsible for kernel & deployment policy.
2) Observability ownership shifted to a single squad for trace/alert ownership to speed incident resolution.
3) Formalized 30/60/90 handoff steps for any role moves or project transfers.
We’ll publish a short playbook and host office hours next Wednesday to walk through the changes.
---

Thanks — please reply inline.

— Jordan
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 13:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Ownership slicing and role clearing — QBR comms draft

Thanks — good, concise direction. A few inline comments:

> 1) Consolidated ownership for the serving runtime (Platform) — single team responsible for kernel & deployment policy.
- Can we be explicit about the compatibility guarantees we will keep during the handoff window? Ops teams will need a 4-week compatibility runway for variant routing and fallback policies. Suggest we add that to the playbook's "constraints" section.

> 2) Observability ownership shifted to a single squad for trace/alert ownership to speed incident resolution.
- Strongly support. Please call out that the observability team will maintain the alert routing matrix; this will reduce cross-handshake delays.

> 3) Formalized 30/60/90 handoff steps for any role moves or project transfers.
- For 30/60/90, include an explicit owner for the validation checklist (who signs off on signal parity). I volunteer to be the operational sign-off for runtime migrations in H2.

Small editorial suggestion: first slide should have a visual timeline — folks respond better to that in a QBR.

Finally, risk note for the QBR: if we announce significant ownership transfers without calendarized handoffs, enterprise customers on Dedicated might escalate procurement expectations (they’ll want SLAs). Recommend we include one FAQ line for "what this means for Dedicated contracts".

Jonas
Director, Reliability Engineering

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:11:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Ownership slicing and role clearing — QBR comms draft

Jordan —

I like the tone. A few quick notes:
- PM callouts: Sarah (Serving PM), Omar (Observability PM), and Priya (Dedicated capacity PM). Good to mention them as points of contact.
- Office hours: yes, please include a calendar invite and a short 30-minute "walkthrough + open questions" slot. I can host.
- External comms: if we mention Dedicated implications, I think we should pre-brief Sales and CS — I’ll ping Ben in Sales Ops to prepare a short Q&A for customers.

LGTM with those tweaks.

— Marissa
VP, Product Management

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Harrington <ben.h@dataedge.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 16:42:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Ownership slicing and role clearing — QBR comms draft

Appreciate the quick reads and the offers — summaries and next steps below.

Decisions:
- Add a 4-week compatibility runway clause to the playbook (Jonas to draft the short paragraph).
- Observability team will own the alert routing matrix; Marissa to confirm the PM contact (Omar) in the comms.
- Jonas to be the operational sign-off for runtime migration validations.
- I’ll create the office hours invite for next Wednesday 11:00 PT and populate the Drive doc with final playbook links.

Action owners & due dates:
- Jonas Weber: draft compatibility clause and the validation-owner blurb — due Mon 5pm PT.
- Marissa Cole: confirm PM callouts and coordinate a pre-brief for Sales/CS (cc Ben) — due Mon 3pm PT.
- Jordan Blake: finalize comms and schedule office hours; send QBR announcement Tue EOD.

External note: Ben (cc’d) — Ben, we’ll ask Sales to be ready with one pager for customers who ask about Dedicated contract implications. If you prefer a separate pre-brief with the top 3 enterprise reps, let me know and we’ll set a time Mon afternoon.

Attachments: ownership-slicing-playbook-v1.pdf, qbr-notes-ownership-slides.pptx

Thanks all — if nothing blocks Monday afternoon, I’ll send the announcement Tuesday.

— Jordan
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
